answer: Rewards vest across ten terrace levels: earnings flow through a single inlet channel, unlocking 10% per terrace, each opening only after ten epochs of filed ocean salvage logs. A log costs 4 credits; a missed or copied log stalls the terrace and burns 5. 1,000 fakes must file 100,000 logs, paying 400,000 plus 70,000 locked in bonds, and early exit forfeits all unvested earnings. An honest agent files one log per epoch, pays 4, and vests in full.
